objective.text: Separate authentication from permission to modify a particular resource.

difficulty.rationale: Add a resource permission check after identifying the caller.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An update endpoint has auth middleware, but every signed-in user can edit another user's private document by changing the document ID. Which missing boundary addresses this without blocking legitimate owners?

options.text: Require the document ID to be an integer.
options.rationale: A well-formed identifier may still identify another user's private document.
options.misconception: A well-formed identifier may still identify another user's private document.

options.text: Hide edit links for nonowners but leave the endpoint unchanged.
options.rationale: Clients can call the endpoint directly; presentation controls do not enforce server-side permission.
options.misconception: Clients can call the endpoint directly; presentation controls do not enforce server-side permission.

options.text: Authorize the update ability against the resolved document and current user before writing.
options.rationale: Authentication identifies the caller; a resource-specific policy can decide whether that caller may update this document.

options.text: Add auth middleware a second time to the same route.
options.rationale: Repeating identity verification does not add a document ownership/permission decision.
options.misconception: Repeating identity verification does not add a document ownership/permission decision.
